name: Magpie — private moodboard, screenshot & bookmark collector
description: Collect images, screenshots and bookmarks into private moodboards on your machine. No account needed; optional paid sync.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob: https:; connect-src 'self' https:

capture-screenshot.description: Screenshot the visible page and clip a region

save-page.description: Save the current page to Magpie as a link

pick-images.description: Pick images on the page to collect
